definitions.K: K is the number of distinct runtime connections in an arrangement. One connection is one (from node, to node, meaning) triple of kind 'runtime' with a piece or a shared part on at least one end, backed by at least one evidence row in that arrangement's own template. K leaves out: links inside the app core (kind 'core'), a piece bringing a shared part (kind 'membership'), deploy-order links (kind 'deploy-order'), deploy-time helper links (kind 'deploy-helper'), and grants on things outside the template (outsideGrants). K is a lookup by arrangement key, never a sum of single-piece counts.
